title: Hinomori Shiho — Hurtful Words〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Uh, well...
We just heard this rumor about you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So...
We heard that you and Homani had a fight...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It was right after school got out and club activities were about to begin, so I was pretty sure that only some people from the indoor clubs would be around...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I guess we were louder than I thought...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry about that...
We said what we needed to and we've made up since.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I got to school this morning, everyone in our class and Honami's were all talking about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, geez... So everyone knows about that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not everyone. Just our class and hers is my guess...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I'd have a hard time believing anyone saying that Honami raising her voice towards someone considering how nice she is to everybody.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The girls I talked to seemed pretty doubtful about it too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll make sure to tell them later that you two have made up already.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you two really did have a fight, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Or rather... She forced me into a corner and made me see her point.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-That's incredible.
She made you change your mind about something?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was just as surprised. I didn't think Honami was capable of raising her voice like that until now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It must've been important. So important that she wasn't willing to budge.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, wait, I think I understand... Was she doing it for you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Getting mad at someone for their own sake is something Honami would do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean, she had to have a reason for doing that. It wouldn't make sense otherwise...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. My mind even started wandering towards you maybe doing something that you weren't supposed to, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What exactly falls into that category in your mind, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right. Littering was the first thing that came to your mind when you heard about what Honami did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Littering isn't good, but you thought Honami would get that mad over something like that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, because she's on the Cleanup Committee!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What kind of person do you think I am, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho! Are you on your way over there?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's a rumor going around about you raising your voice towards someone, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I heard.
Everyone in my class couldn't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But everything's okay now.
I told them all what happened and they seemed to understand.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, word reached my class too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori somehow convinced herself that you were mad at me because I was littering or something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that would bother me a little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because you're on the Cleanup Committee?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think it's important to be there to tell your friends if they're doing something that you feel isn't right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll be more careful from now on.
